svg.title: An error budget tracks how much unreliability is still allowed
svg.desc: An SLO defines a target. The gap between the target and perfect reliability is the error budget; consuming it changes priorities toward stability.
svg.text: Consuming the error budget shifts focus from features to stability
SLO target: 99.5% successful pipeline runs this quarter
While budget remains: ship changes at normal pace.
When budget is exhausted: pause new releases, prioritize reliability work until the budget resets.
The SLO is the target; the error budget is what is spent when reality falls short of it.
